failures.title: Intermittent uncaught page error 'reading isReady' (three.js compileAsync on a disposed material)
failures.evidence: captures/gntccampaign5-legacy-prod.json has 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'isReady')' at three-D_OVNSxA.js:4108:31133, on boot ?level=3&seed=4&fresh=1 under machine load. That is WebGLRenderer.compileAsync polling properties.get(material).currentProgram.isReady() on a material that was disposed while its compile was pending. The error is thrown from a setTimeout and that promise never settles. Rate: 1 of about 76 boots and player paths (tools/gntccampaign5-isready.mjs, -isready2.mjs). It breaks GC.13 / GP.16 '0 page errors'.
